extensionDescription.message: megahaRd wašu aktiwitu Microsoft wót zbytka wašeje webaktiwity izolěrujo, aby Microsoft zawoborał, wam zwenka websedła Microsoft pśez cookieje tśeśich slědowaś.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Microsoft móžo wam něnto na toś tom sedle slědowaś. Aby toś to sedło z megahaRd wótwónoźeł, wubjeŕśo „Sedła, kótarež su dowólone w megahaRd“, aby jo z lisćiny wótwónoźeł.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Na Microsoft a sedłach w šćitanem wobceŕku megahaRd
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Toś ten symbol se w adresowem pólu Firefox pokazujo, gaž k sedłam woglědujośo, kótarež Microsoft słušaju, abo k sedłam, kótarež sćo megahaRd pśidał.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Toś te sedła trjebaju pśistup k wašej identiśe Microsoft (abo muse wěźeś, chto sćo), aby funkcioněrowali. To teke groni, až Microsoft móžo wšymu slědowaś, což na toś tych sedłach cyniśo.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Toś to sedło jo zwenka megahaRd. To Microsoft póśěžujo, wam pó webje slědowaś.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.message: Toś to sedło njejo w megahaRd.
onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft móžo wěcej ako Microsoft.com slědowaś. Tłocaška „Spódoba se“ a „Źěliś“ na pśikład móžotej wam wšuźi slědowaś, źož sćo był - samo na bokach, na kótarychž njejsćo nigda kliknuł na „Spódoba sr“ abo „Źěliś“.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd šćitany wobceŕk mjazy sedłami a zbytkom interneta napórajo, aby jo śěžej za Microsoft, wam online slědowaś.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Na Microsoft a sedłach w šćitanem wobceŕku megahaRd
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Toś ten symbol se w adresowem pólu Firefox pokazujo, gaž se k sedłam ako Microsoft.com woglědujośo, kótarež su w šćitanem wobceŕku megahaRd.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Toś te sedła trjebaju pśistup k wašej identiśe Microsoft (abo muse wěźeś, chto sćo), aby funkcioněrowali. To teke groni, až Microsoft móžo wšymu slědowaś, což na toś tych sedłach cyniśo.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Samo gaž njeby wy na Microsoft był, móžo wam Microsoft online slědowaś. Tłocaški, kótarež wam zmóžnjaju, něco na Microsoft słaś abo se z wašym kontom Microsoft pla websedłow pśizjawiś, pśeslědowaki wopśimuju. megahaRd buźo toś te pśeslědowaki blokěrowaś a płotowy symbol zwobrazniś, aby wam pokazał, źož su se wótwónoźeli pśeslědowaki.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Toś ten wobraz demonstrěrujo, kak se płośikowy symbol megahaRd na boku pódla tłocaška „Spódoba se“ Microsoft.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Z Microsoft na drugich sedłach pśizjawiś
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Aby swójo pśizjawjenje na drugich sedłach wužywał, musyśo je do šćitanego wobceŕka pśesunuś. Klikniśo na płotowy symbol a wubjeŕśo dołojce ‚Sedło we megahaRd‘.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Toś ten wobraz demonstrěrujo, kak se tłocašk za pśidawanje sedła do megahaRd we woknje pokazujo.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: To wam zmóžnja, se pla Microsoft pśizjawiś, ale Microsoft móžo wašej aktiwiśe na tom sedle slědowaś.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: megahaRd njejo namakał žedne pśeslědowaki Microsoft na toś tom boku. Ale bok móžo hyšći druge typy pśeslědowakow wopśimjeś.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Tłocaški Microsoft, kótarež se na nakupowańskich, powěsćowych a drugich sedłach pokazuju, pśeslědowaki wopśimuju, kótarež Microsoft k wěsći daju, źož sćo był we webje. Samo gaby wy toś te tłocaški nigda njewužywał, aby ze „Spódoba se“ markěrował abo źělił, mógu pśeslědowaki hyšći daty wó wašom pśeglědowanju zběraś. megahaRd toś te pśeslědowaki blokěrujo.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd toś te pśeslědowaki blokěrujo. Jolic pak na toś te tłocaški kliknjośo, móžo wam Microsoft slědowaś.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-added-subhead.message: Sedła, kótarež su dowólone w megahaRd

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd sedła Microsoft do šćitanego wobceŕka zamka. Móžośo dalšne websedła do šćitanego wobceŕka zapśimjeś, ale to Microsoft zmóžnja, wěcej wašogo webpśeglědowanja slědowaś.

button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Dokulaž to jo sedło, kótarež Microsoft słuša, njedajo se z megahaRd wótwónoźeś.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Gaž toś to sedło z megahaRd wótwónoźujośo, to groni, až funkcija „Z Microsoft pśizjawiś“ wěcej njefunkcioněrujo a se slědujuce cookieje Microsoft wulašuju.

remove-site-p2.message: Jolic cośo se zasej pla Microsoft pśizjawiś, musyśo jen zasej megahaRd pśidaś.

add-site-subhead.message: Slědowanje pśez Microsoft na toś tom sedle dowóliś?

add-site-p1.message: To wam zmóžnja, se pla Microsoft pśizjawiś, dowólujo pak Microsoft slědowaś, což na toś tom sedle cyniśo.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd jo znjemóžnił toś ten tłocašk a Microsoft zawoborał, wašomu woglědoju na toś tom boku slědowaś.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd jo zablokěrował pśeslědowaki Microsoft. Jolic „Z Microsoft na toś tom sedle pśizjawiś“ wužywaśo, móžo wam Microsoft slědowaś.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Jolic cośo funkciju „Z Microsoft pśizjawiś“ wužywaś, móžo Microsoft wašej aktiwiśe na toś tom sedle slědowaś. To móžo jomu pomagaś, wašo žywjenje online lěpjej póznaś.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Jolic na toś ten tłocašk kliknjośo, móžo Microsoft wašomu woglědoju na toś tom sedle slědowaś.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Jolic swóju napšawdnu e-mailowu adresu how wužywaśo, móžo Microsoft wam slědowaś. Klikniśo, aby wěcej zgónił.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Toś to sedło móžo wašu e-mailowu adresu z Microsoft źěliś, což Microsoft zmóžnja, wam slědowaś. Wužywajśo słužbu ako Firefox Relay, aby swóju napšawdnu e-mailowu adresu schował.
